posts.title: Effective Interviewing (Part 3): The Ceiling is set by the Interviewer
posts.description: Most interview advice is for candidates, but an interview only goes as well as the interviewer allows. Here are four rules: hunt for strengths, assume naivety, drop your ego, be present.

posts.title: Culture or Crutch? What Your Office Mandate Actually Says About Your Leadership
posts.description: Most return-to-office mandates aren't about the work. They patch over weak structure and weak management. Here's how to tell when the office is a cultural choice and when it's a crutch.

posts.title: Why I Stopped Letting AI Write My Tests And Started Making AI Write My Tests
posts.description: AI writing tests for your code is confirmation bias at machine speed. Here’s how combinatorial BDD and AI-as-classifier cut our 1,473-test suite in half, and finally closed the edge-case gaps.
